title: Licensed Beverage Conditions Across the Private Event & Banquet Services Packages
content:
Licensed beverage service is not offered on every Private Event & Banquet Services package, and where it is offered the package prints the smallest beverage spend required where a bar is opened and the charge for each bottle the client supplies themselves.

| Package | Licensed beverage service may be ordered | Bar minimum, USD | Corkage for each bottle the client supplies, USD |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Meeting Room Refreshment Package | No | 0 | 0 |
| Boardroom Reception Package | Yes | 0 | 18 |
| Conference Day Delegate Package | Yes | 750 | 22 |
| Seated Banquet Package | Yes | 1800 | 26 |
| Gala Reception Package | Yes | 4500 | 34 |
| Multi-Day Conference Residency Package | Yes | 9500 | 28 |

The first column states whether licensed beverage service may be ordered on the package at all. The bar minimum is the smallest beverage spend required where a bar is opened, and the corkage column is the charge for each bottle the client supplies themselves.

## Points of judgement on the columns

Licensed beverage service and a bar minimum are two different questions. The Boardroom Reception Package permits licensed beverage service and prints a bar minimum of 0, so a bar may be opened on it without a beverage spend being required. The Meeting Room Refreshment Package permits no licensed beverage service and prints 0 in both money columns.

Corkage does not simply rise with the size of the package: it climbs from 18 on the Boardroom Reception Package to 34 on the Gala Reception Package and then falls to 28 on the Multi-Day Conference Residency Package, whose bar minimum of 9500 is nonetheless the largest on the schedule.
